goal: The deployment image no longer ships the third-party toml package, so importing app fails. Migrate the app package to the standard-library tomllib (Python 3.11) and remove the toml dependency from both requirements.txt and the [project] dependencies in pyproject.toml, keeping the other dependencies. load_config(path) in app/config.py must keep accepting a str or a pathlib.Path and returning a dict, and invalid TOML must raise app.config.ConfigError with the file name in the message. Do not change the tests.
